title: 第5章 致命警告
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“滴——滴——滴——”

忽然办公室内警报器骤响，刺得人头皮发麻。

刺耳的警报声响彻了永夜局的大楼。

人都哪去了？为什么警报声一直在响，但大楼内却像死一般的寂静，她感受不到任何有人类活动的气息。

她小心翼翼地往前走去，长长的走廊两侧是三个相互对着的门，此时正全部紧闭。

抬头巡视了一圈，发现走廊的监控仍然在亮着，但是否有在工作中就不得而知。

她轻轻敲了两下，离自己最近的那间办公室的门。

没有回应。

一定有什么被忽略了。

虽然她现在很想知道门内情况，但此时毫无准备，贸然推开门根本无法应对。

快速思索后她决定先退回自己办公室，更重要的是她要回办公室确认一件事。

只见司陇背贴着墙壁，快速地回到了自己办公室内，却并没有立马去关上门。

走廊上刺耳的警铃依旧作响，但关上门会将恐怖藏于未知，不利于她第一时间发现危险做出应对。

她谨慎地挪步至窗前，向窗外看去。

下一秒，她的心瞬间凉到谷底。

先前在窗外看到的行人竟全部消失。

她终于知道那死一般的寂静从何而来。

【致命警告】玩家危险躲避天赋触发！

视线右上角忽然跳出红色闪动提示框！

只一眼，她仿佛战斗过无数回的身体，条件反射般地向后退去，同时上半身以极其诡异的弯曲姿态向侧后方仰去。

顷刻间，三把极速匕首从窗外飞进室内，途径她刚刚所站的地方，深深地插进身后的墙壁之中。

司陇迅速回头警戒地看向窗外，同时右手已经牢牢握在腰侧的脉冲枪上。

整栋大楼的警报声在此刻戛然静止。

一道男声从走廊深处传来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Dip-dip-dip-"

Suddenly the alarm in the office went off, causing people's scalp to go numb.

The piercing siren sounded throughout the Evernight Bureau building.

Where have all the people gone?Why was the alarm sounding all the time, but the building was as quiet as death? She couldn't feel any human activity.

She walked forward cautiously. There were three doors facing each other on both sides of the long corridor, all of which were now closed.

I looked up and looked around and found that the surveillance camera in the corridor was still on, but it was unclear whether it was working.

She knocked twice on the door of the office closest to her.

No response.

Something must have been overlooked.

Although she wanted to know what was going on inside the door now, she was unprepared at this moment and hurriedly opened the door, unable to deal with it.

After thinking quickly, she decided to return to her office first. More importantly, she wanted to go back to her office to confirm one thing.

Si Long was seen with his back against the wall and quickly returned to his office, but did not close the door immediately.

The piercing alarm bell in the corridor is still ringing, but closing the door will hide the horror in the unknown, which is not conducive to her being able to detect danger and respond immediately.

She cautiously moved to the window and looked out.

The next second, her heart suddenly dropped to the bottom.

All the pedestrians I saw outside the window disappeared.

She finally knew where the deathly silence came from.

[Fatal Warning] Player’s danger avoidance talent is triggered!

A red flashing prompt box suddenly popped up in the upper right corner of your sight!

With just one glance, her body seemed to have fought countless times, retreating backwards reflexively, while at the same time her upper body leaned sideways and rearward in an extremely weird curved posture.

In an instant, three extremely fast daggers flew into the room from the window, passed where she had just stood, and penetrated deeply into the wall behind her.

Si Long quickly turned back and looked out the window warily, while his right hand was already firmly holding the pulse gun at his waist.

The sirens throughout the building suddenly stopped.

A male voice came from deep in the corridor.
